item.title: Stranded American in Bahrain recounts surviving reported Iranian strike on high-rise building, pleads for help
item.summary: An American tourist in Bahrain described a terrifying drone strike on his building as the Iran conflict escalates, leaving thousands of citizens stranded abroad.

item.title: Ex-Navy SEAL warns withdrawing from Iran now would hand 'victory' to regime
item.summary: Vice admiral warns halting Iran military action would empower regime amid rising oil prices, arguing Operation Epic Fury must continue to prevent a nuclear threat.

item.title: Ted Cruz shuts down extended Iran war talk, says it's 'not Iraq' amid oil price spike
item.summary: Sen. Ted Cruz said Tuesday that there was likely no possibility the Iran war would become an extended military engagement and said it was "not Iraq."

item.title: Trump's pick to lead the Federal Reserve meets GOP senator holding up his confirmation
item.summary: Kevin Warsh's path to leading the Federal Reserve faces a hurdle as a Senate member holds up the nomination over ongoing Justice Department probe concerns.

item.title: DOJ accelerates settlement offers in Camp Lejeune water contamination cases
item.summary: Camp Lejeune Justice Department settlements accelerate as Stanley Woodward approves 649 offers totaling $175 million in three weeks for contaminated water victims.

item.title: Major airline suspends Abu Dhabi flights until end of year amid airspace 'uncertainty'
item.summary: UAE flights are suspended after British Airways, Lufthansa cancel service to Dubai and Abu Dhabi amid the latest Middle East tensions. Airports are restricting access.

item.title: Randy Arozarena tells Mariners teammate Cal Raleigh to 'go f--- himself' after WBC handshake snub
item.summary: Randy Arozarena delivered an explosive response to teammate Cal Raleigh's handshake refusal after their USA-Mexico World Baseball Classic face-off went viral.

item.title: McIntosh: Midterms a choice between Trump’s ‘great progress’ and ‘socialists back in’
item.summary: The fiscally conservative group Club for Growth plans $175 million midterm spending to help Republicans keep House and Senate majorities, targeting Trump voters who may skip midterms.

item.title: Trump ally endorses Paxton over Cornyn as GOP Senate primary heads to high-stakes Texas runoff
item.summary: GOP Rep. Eric Burlison of Missouri endorsed Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton in a Lone Star State Republican U.S. Senate primary runoff.

item.title: 'Pulp Fiction' director Quentin Tarantino blasts Rosanna Arquette for trashing film after she ‘took the money’
item.summary: Rosanna Arquette denounced Quentin Tarantino's N-word usage as racist, prompting the "Pulp Fiction" director to question her motives and timing.
